state.proof: Actual-C boot sequence passes248 cases/ten compiled mutants. Probe/IRQ/work/lease code passes265 cases,three mutants and one original-source control exposing false publication after a launch error. Exact packaged AArch64 provider is imported into Ghidra,full auto-analysis completes,its one selected probe function decompiles with zero failures and contains the inlined error/version/latch checks. Native raw boot from C-published bytes accepts version before DISCOVER with nonce slots still zero,then parks eight harts. Complete world/offline image and raw ownership tests pass with external kernel/native dependencies modeled.
state.reset: Current6.18.52 reset source exactly reconstructs. All147 IDs,23,088 host and5,007 target-compiled AArch64 callback cases pass with modeled regmap. NPU8 maps bank0x830/bit9. Other GDMA/WDMA/WOE/HSDMA/TDMA/FE-related entries remain separate. NPU DTS still has no reset binding. No physical assertion,drain,router contact,flash or client test occurred.
state.retention: The existing exposure latch retains all coherent mailboxes/device/module lifetime after any potentially visible copy or launch operation. Boot errors do not add retry,reset,rollback or free. A successful version reply does not certify prior-user exclusion or all physical owners.

launch_errors.instructions: Does launch return immediately on the first failed existing boot-register write rather than continuing programming?

legacy_scope.instructions: Does launch preserve optional legacy version reporting while keeping common write failures fatal?

one_attempt.instructions: Does launch latch the attempt before any boot write and reject a later launch without I/O?

failure_resources.instructions: What resource behavior does retention describe after a possibly visible launch error?

binary_scope.instructions: Which new packaged-binary observation is supported by proof?

criteria.ghidra: Exact packaged probe/inlined launch analyzed and decompiled; hardware not run.

reset_coverage.instructions: Does reset prove physical exclusion and retirement of every independent NPU/DMA owner?

whole_goal.instructions: Do proof,reset and retention establish complete NPU implementation and physical/client acceptance?
